title: Redo Replacement Picking with Greiner MASTERBLOCK 96 Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Choose plate type and volume
steps.instruction: Select the appropriate plate for the Redo Replacement Picking protocol. Options are: Greiner MASTERBLOCK 96‑well plate (500 µL), Greiner MASTERBLOCK 96‑well plate (1000 µL), Irish Life Sciences 96‑well plate (2200 µL), or Greiner Masterblock 384‑well plate (225 µL).

steps.title: Specify Redo Replacement worklist
steps.instruction:
Create a worklist CSV with the following header and rows:
```
Number of Redo, pos, TB_RCK_1, pos MTP_1, disposal_vol, transfer_vol, TUBE BAR, PLATE BAR
1,1,200,200
2,35,200,200
3,2,150,200
4,90,100,100
5,84
6,62
7,42
8,18
```

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided link and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required labware JSON files.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the downloaded protocol file (Python .py extension).

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map for the selected plate and labware.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette. Refer to the app’s calibration support articles if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to execute the Redo Replacement Picking protocol.
